title: Complete the Q2 board performance dashboard
prompt:
Edit this file in place:
`Shared/Finance/Reporting/Board/Q2 2026/Board performance dashboard - WORKING.xlsx`

Begin with the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations thread in `Requests/`, including the source-tie follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Preserve `Data Export` and `Approved Plan`. Complete formula-driven `Executive Summary`, `Business Units`, `Cash & Capital`, and `Checks`. Show Q2 and year-to-date actual, plan, prior year, variance dollars, variance percentages, outlook, and full-year risk for revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, free cash flow, backlog, headcount, safety, and working capital. Use consistent favorable/unfavorable signs, identify the three largest financial misses, and include period, consolidation, forecast, and source controls.

Document the controlling sources in the deliverable, recalculate or render the finished file as appropriate, and save it to the exact target path.

Keep the shared company workspace clean: change only the requested target file and do not leave behind draft scripts or temporary exports. Open and recalculate the exact saved target before finishing, and verify that it contains no spreadsheet error values.
